title: Finishing Through Contact With a Pad
description: A coach holds a soft pad to create realistic chair-to-chair contact as players finish through it, building confidence finishing when a defender is right there.

content.objective: Finish through realistic contact without losing control of the chair or the ball.
content.setup: A coach or teammate holds a soft contact pad near the block; the shooter approaches from the wing.
instructions: Push in from the wing toward the rim at a controlled pace.
Accept light contact from the pad as the chair arrives at the basket.
Finish through the contact, keeping the ball protected with the off-arm.
Rotate so every player gets several reps through the pad.
coachingPoints: Gather the ball securely before the contact arrives.
Keep the chair stable through the contact rather than bracing away from it.
Finish the shot rather than flinching away from the pad.
commonMistakes: Slowing down before contact instead of finishing through it.
Losing the ball on contact from loose handling.
Bringing the ball down low where it can be knocked away.
content.safety: The pad holder applies only light, controlled pressure, never a hard check.
